temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth says she is not upset with him; she has been curt because of personal stuff and apologizes if she seemed short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth might be upset with him, possibly due to a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake he made.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he learns her curtness is not anger toward him but due to personal stress, so his suspicion is corrected.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not upset with him; she is dealing with personal issues.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be understanding and offer support if she wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth accepts his offer of a coffee break, calls it kind, and thanks him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress unrelated to him and may appreciate support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; her acceptance confirms she is receptive to his support and a coffee break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth welcomes his support and has agreed to spend a coffee break with him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To listen and offer support during the coffee break.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over coffee, Elizabeth shares more about her stresses, which seem severe; she says she has thought about professional help but is hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is dealing with significant personal stress and is open to his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he now believes professional help might benefit her, but he is concerned about how to suggest it without offending her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth may need professional help, but she is hesitant and uncertain, so the topic must be handled carefully.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support her in considering professional help without pressuring her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After his suggestion, Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn; then she reassures him that he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, and says it is a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Professional help might benefit Elizabeth, but she is hesitant; he is worried about offending her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he first interprets her withdrawal as possible embarrassment or overstepping, then her reassurance corrects that to she is not offended but is processing a lot.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: He did not overstep; Elizabeth appreciates his concern but needs time to think.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially regretful, then relieved but still concerned
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure her, avoid pushing, and continue offering support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative; she says his support means a lot and she feels better knowing she has it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth appreciates his concern but is processing a lot; he needs to avoid overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; her openness and thanks confirm she values his support and feels more comfortable.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support and feels better because of it; their supportive relationship is positive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain the supportive relationship and remain available to chat or take breaks.
